description: A price range for the job researched from local prices (with where the prices came from), not a quote. Contacts no one. Returns an estimateId; an estimateId passed with car_send_request gives the business the same scope and range. No sign-in needed.

answers.description: Question id -> option value (a list for multi-choice questions)

where.description: "City, ST" when there is no ZIP

name: car_get_estimate
